statistic: for each of the eight cells (G2, G3) x (0.5, 1, 2, 4), the bootstrap draws are centred at the cell's mean and studentised by the cell's bootstrap standard deviation floored at 1e-12; the critical value is the 95th percentile over draws of the maximum studentised deviation across the eight cells, and the one-sided upper bound is point + critical * sd per cell
degenerate_cells: cells whose selected policy is identical in every replicate have deviation identically zero; they contribute zero to each draw's maximum and their bound equals their point estimate
